showcase.title: Care built around how you move.
showcase.description: Each condition is different. Treatment begins by understanding your movement, your goals, and what your body needs to progress.

sports-injuries.title: Sports Injuries
sports-injuries.description: Supporting recovery from injuries that affect movement and performance, with a focus on restoring function and progressing safely back to activity.
sports-injuries.keyFocus: Movement mechanics analysis, pain regulation, restoring elasticity and functional capacity.

back-pain.title: Back Pain
back-pain.description: Understanding the factors associated with back pain and working toward better movement and everyday function.
back-pain.keyFocus: Postural and movement analysis, core stabilization, reducing kinetic load.
back-pain.imageAlt: Physiotherapy assessment and treatment for back pain

joint-pain.title: Joint Pain
joint-pain.description: A movement- and function-focused approach to helping patients manage joint pain and improve mobility.
joint-pain.keyFocus: Restoring joint range of motion (knee, shoulder, hip), strengthening supporting musculature.
joint-pain.imageAlt: Physiotherapy care focused on joint mobility

rehabilitation.title: Rehabilitation
rehabilitation.description: A structured journey toward restoring movement, function, and confidence in using your body again.
rehabilitation.keyFocus: Post-operative rehab, reconditioning after prolonged inactivity, neuromuscular balance.

sports-rehabilitation.title: Sports Rehabilitation
sports-rehabilitation.description: Focused rehabilitation to restore movement and performance and support a gradual return to sport.
sports-rehabilitation.keyFocus: Return-to-sport physical readiness tests, sport-specific conditioning, re-injury prevention.
